title: Why Classes
goal: This lesson covers why classes help you model real things that have their own data and actions.
learn: One blueprint can make many things
Classes group data and actions together
idea: A class is a blueprint for a kind of thing, like pets, players, or accounts. Why bother? Because you can make many similar things without copying and pasting the same variables again and again. Classes group data, which is what a thing knows, with actions, which is what it can do. You will meet the actions later.

lines: print("Objects are things built from it")
print("Each object can have its own data")
output: Objects are things built from it
Each object can have its own data

changeOneLine: In the editor above, change the last line to mention name or age and press Run.

practice.text: Print two sentences: what a class is, and why it helps.
practice.hint: Use two print() lines. The first says a class is like a blueprint. The second says why that helps, with many similar things and less copy and paste.
practice.starterTip: Try print("A class is a blueprint") then print("You can make many objects from one class").
practice.gradingNote: Pass if two non-empty prints about blueprint/objects/classes.

practice.text: Print an example of one class name and two different object ideas.
practice.hint: You already have Class: Pet. Fill the two blank prints with two different pet names or ideas, and make sure they are not the same.
practice.starterTip: For example: print("Object: Mochi the cat") and print("Object: Buddy the dog").
practice.gradingNote: Pass if two different pet/object ideas print.

quiz.question: What is a class?
quiz.correct: Right, a class describes a kind of thing.

quiz.question: Why use classes?

options.text: To model many similar things cleanly

quiz.correct: Yes, one blueprint can make many things.
quiz.wrong: That means less copy and paste.

quiz.question: Do all objects from a class share the exact same data?

options.text: No. Each can store its own values

quiz.correct: Right, each object can store its own values.
quiz.wrong: Buddy and Luna are different pets.
